message.content:
The given equations are squared distances between three points:

\[
P_1=(x_1,y_1),\quad P_2=(x_2,y_2),\quad P_3=(x_3,y_3).
\]

Thus

\[
P_1P_2=3,\qquad P_1P_3=4,\qquad P_2P_3=5.
\]

So the triangle has side lengths \(3,4,5\), which is a right triangle with legs \(3\) and \(4\). Its area is

\[
\frac12\cdot 3\cdot 4=6.
\]

The determinant

\[
\begin{vmatrix}
x_1 & y_1 & 1\\
x_2 & y_2 & 1\\
x_3 & y_3 & 1
\end{vmatrix}
\]

equals twice the signed area of the triangle. Therefore its square is

\[
(2\cdot 6)^2=144.
\]

\[
\boxed{144}
\]
